title: The Gospels: Four Testimonies of the Savior
author: Gaye Strathearn, Associate Dean of Religious Education, Brigham Young University,and Frank F. Judd Jr., Professor of Ancient Scripture, Brigham Young University

footnotes.text: SeeEusebius: The Church History, trans. Paul L. Maier (2007), 113–14 (3.39.15–16).

The Sermon on the Mount (Matthew 5–7); the apostolic commission (Matthew 10); the parables discourse (Matthew 13); the community rules discourse (Matthew 18); and the Olivet discourse (Matthew 24–25).
